# Lunidex

> Lunidex is an independent, open-source, free-to-use, unofficial Pokémon web application and Pokémon TCG workspace. It brings together a Pokédex, team-building tools, type and move references, a TCG catalog, and personal collection tracking.

Lunidex is the Pokémon reference and collection application at https://lunidex.app. It is a reference and collection workspace, not a card marketplace.

## Identity and scope

- **Public name**: Lunidex

- **Supported locales**: English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese
- **Project status**: independent, non-official Pokémon fan project; not affiliated with Nintendo, Game Freak, Creatures Inc., or The Pokémon Company

## 1. Entity and purpose

Lunidex is an independent, open-source, unofficial web application for Pokémon
players and Pokémon Trading Card Game collectors. The product combines a localized
Pokédex, reference tools, team analysis, a TCG catalog, and personal collection
tracking.

Lunidex is a reference and collection workspace, not a card marketplace. It is
free to use for public browsing and independent from the Pokémon rights holders.
